item.title: DAKOTA FLINT CLIP-ON SURVIVAL WATCH
item.description: The Dakota Flint Clip On Survival Watch is built for people who want more than just a time display on their wrist. item.title: WINGCUBE FOLDING TENT BOX
item.description: Wingcube Folding Tent Box is a bold new concept that reimagines what a compact camper can be. Designed as a tall, narrow cube that rides on top of a separate trailer, it expands at camp into a mushroom shaped platform tent with two raised bedrooms and a central outdoor living zone. The idea is simple but clever: tow a compact box that is easy to maneuver, then unfold it in minutes into a space that feels far larger than its footprint. item.title: THE GOOD PATCH
item.description: The Good Patch offers a simple approach to everyday wellness with plant powered dermal patches designed to support recovery, sleep, stress relief, energy and more.
